subject: Helios Medical staging: control-plane attestation & egress evidence
content:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@heliosmed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliosmed.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staging evidence request for private VPC deployment

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the staging walkthrough yesterday. The security team at Helios needs an attestation bundle and selective egress evidence for our Private VPC trial before we can sign off to move to a production pilot. Can you confirm we can provide the following by EOD Friday?

- Control plane/process separation attestation (high level description + manifest)
- Sample KV-cache/metadata access logs showing no cross-tenant leakage (redacted)
- Staging egress snapshot (last 24h) showing destination IPs/domains and associated flows
- A short runbook for how you handle fallback routing/region failover for our tenant

If you can also include any SOC2-relevant mappings (where logs are retained, who can access them), that would be helpful.

Appreciate it — Alice

---
Alice Chen
Security Program Manager, Helios Medical
alice.chen@heliosmed.com
---


From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@heliosmed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging evidence request for private VPC deployment

Alice —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can provide the attestation bundle and evidence you outlined. High-level plan and what you will receive:

1) Control plane attestation:
   - Narrative that describes separation between the control plane (management APIs, orchestration) and the data plane (inference pods, KV cache).
   - Deployment manifest (attached) highlighting namespaces, RBAC roles, and network ACLs for Helios tenant.

2) Logs and egress snapshot:
   - Staging egress snapshot (CSV) with destinations, ports, and byte counts for a 24h window (attached). Sensitive fields redacted.
   - KV/metadata access logs: sample activity for Helios tenant with user/service principal identifiers pseudonymized.

3) Runbook & failover:
   - Short runbook (.pdf attached) describing canary failover sequence, model fallback, and region routing policies.

4) SOC2 mapping notes:
   - Where logs are stored (encrypted S3 in customer region), retention window, and role names with access.

Action items / timeline:
- I will share the attestation-checklist.pdf and controlplane-deploy-manifest.yaml now (attached).
- Ben will export the 24h egress snapshot and the sample KV access logs by EOD today.
- Kimberly will provide the SOC2 mapping notes and a short paragraph about our access controls by tomorrow morning.

If anything in the attachments is insufficient, flag the exact artifact and we’ll iterate.

Priyom

--
Priyom Das
Platform Security Lead, Redwood Inference
priyom@redwood.com

[attachment: attestation-checklist.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: controlplane-deploy-manifest.yaml (yaml)]


From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Alice Chen <alice.chen@heliosmed.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging evidence request for private VPC deployment

PRIYOM / KIM —

I attached the 24h egress snapshot (staging-egress-log-snapshot.csv). Notes on generation and caveats:
- Snapshot generated from our egress-proxy aggregator for the Helios staging tenant between 2026-10-07T00:00Z and 2026-10-07T23:59Z.
- IPs to DNS mapping uses PTR where available; domains are shown for HTTP/S flows.
- We redacted internal hostnames and replaced user/service principals with tokenized IDs.

Control plane evidence: the manifest shows dedicated orchestration cluster namespaces and dedicated GKE node pools (for on-prem this is the equivalent staging node slice). The key assurance is that control-plane APIs are only reachable from the management VPC over restricted peering and mTLS.

Kimberly — can you add the retention/roles paragraph here so I can forward a single package to Alice? Also confirm whether we should include a short graph (timeline) of a failover event from last month as an example.

Ben

[attachment: staging-egress-log-snapshot.csv (csv)]


From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Alice Chen <alice.chen@heliosmed.com>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Staging evidence request for private VPC deployment

Adding the SOC2 mapping details and a short confirmation on retention/roles below — sending as part of the final package to Helios.

- Log storage: encrypted object store in customer-controlled S3 bucket (us-west-2). Server-side encryption with customer KMS is available for Private deployments.
- Retention: default 90 days for staging; production retention is configurable per contract (30/90/365).
- Access: Access is role-based. Roles with access to raw logs: Platform-SRE, Security-Incident-Response. Both roles require 2FA and audit logging on access.
- Audit trail: every read of log objects is logged to audit trail and retained for 365 days.

We will include a short failover timeline graphic (PNG) from an August canary where we failed a pod group and the control plane moved traffic to the warm standby. I recommend we annotate the graphic with the decision points we used during the canary.

Priyom — Ben has compiled the artifacts. Please forward the package to Alice and confirm a delivery ETA to procurement for their records.

Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Compliance Integrations, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

[attachment: attestation-package.zip (zip)]


-----
Helios procurement reply expected: precinct confirmation + ask for any additional PoC metrics.
